data.gender_notes: Malesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Malesh is a Hindu name meaning 'Lord of the Mountain'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Mahadeva', which means 'great god'. Malesh is a powerful and strong name, evoking images of the mighty Himalayas and the gods that reside there. The name Malesh carries the meaning “Lord of the Mountain” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Malesh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
